title: Enterprise OSS gateway program
description: Deliver an independently maintained Apache-2.0 Bifrost fork with distributed governance, identity-driven entitlements, HA routing, safe replay, an honest dashboard, and verified release artifacts. Completion requires the twelve global acceptance tests in docs/roadmap/enterprise-oss-program.md plus file-level provenance and license compliance.

title: E0 Fork provenance, stable baseline, and verified gap audit
description: Inventory every layer as present/partial/stub/absent; establish fork/upstream remote policy after owner supplies destination; pin component versions; baseline builds/tests/benchmarks; enforce license, notices, modification markers, and provenance ledger.

title: E1 Governance schemas and shared security invariants
description: Define tenant/principal/policy/key versions, control-plane RBAC versus data-plane entitlements, a single deny-by-default evaluator shared by model listing and inference, capability manifest, audit envelope, and cache-version contracts.

title: E2 Distributed virtual-key lifecycle
description: Harden existing OSS key CRUD with reveal-once hashed secrets, status/expiry/not-before, transactional rotation/revocation, versioned cross-pod invalidation, bounded stale-cache fail-closed behavior, audited bulk operations, and three-pod tests.

title: E3 Atomic hierarchical quotas and budgets
description: Implement shared atomic RPM/TPM/spend reservations and actual-usage reconciliation across global/BU/customer/team/user/profile/key/provider/model scopes, immediate audited top-ups, precise 429 responses, stuck-reservation repair, and partition semantics.

title: E4 OIDC, SCIM, Okta reconciliation, and entitlements
description: Implement OIDC Authorization Code with PKCE, standards-complete inbound SCIM Users/Groups, separate Okta directory importer, group-to-role/team/BU/access-profile mappings, lifecycle deprovisioning, managed-key issuance, and explain-access.

title: E5 Horizontal scaling and cluster operations
description: Make request pods stateless around durable config and shared counters; implement membership/invalidation, readiness/drain, migration locks, leader leases, HPA metrics, PDB/topology/network policy, rolling upgrades, and multi-zone failure tests.

title: E6 Adaptive routing, circuits, canaries, and shadows
description: Build the staged policy engine without bypassing entitlements; add health-weighted provider/key selection, circuit breakers, deterministic cohort canaries, separately budgeted side-effect-safe shadows, promotion gates, rollback, and decision explanations.

title: E7 Secure traces, replay, evaluation, and environment export
description: Emit OTEL/OpenInference-correlated trace envelopes with separated encrypted payloads; add side-effect-disabled replay, config snapshots, diffs/evaluators/promotion gates, and reviewed exports compatible with external RL/eval environment concepts.

title: E8 Honest enterprise operations dashboard
description: Replace or capability-hide stubs and cost cruft. Ship only API-backed Keys, Identity, Entitlements, Limits, Routing, Cluster, Traces/Replays, Audit, and reconciled-cost surfaces with RBAC, accessibility, and Playwright coverage.

title: E9 Threat model, audit integrity, and security verification
description: Threat-model tenant escape, stale auth, key theft, counter bypass, confused deputy, replay effects, SSRF and injection; add envelope encryption, redaction, tenant query scoping, tamper-evident audit, fuzz/race/chaos tests, and disclosure policy.

title: E10 Reproducible build, packaging, signing, and release
description: Adapt upstream workflows for the fork; emit cross-platform binaries, multi-arch OCI image, Helm chart, source archives, checksums, SBOM, license bundle, signatures and provenance; gate on tests, upgrades, scans, benchmarks, and asset verification.

title: E11 Agent flywheel and quality gates
description: Review the plan through strong-model rounds, polish beads to steady state, validate the DAG with br/bv robot modes, then use a small NTM swarm with one-bead claims and file reservations. Do not implement Wayfinder unless a concrete uncovered gap remains.

title: Publish layer-by-layer OSS and enterprise seam matrix
description: For every target feature classify schema, migration, store, service, API, authz, UI, Helm/config, telemetry, unit, integration, multi-pod, docs and packaging as present/partial/stub/absent with source file-and-line evidence. Existing OSS behavior must be extended, not reimplemented.

title: Pin stable component baseline and record build/test/benchmark evidence
description: Compare current main checkout with latest stable independently tagged modules, select the baseline deliberately, record Go/UI/toolchain versions, run non-secret build and test suites, capture benchmark methodology and negative evidence, and document upstream update strategy.

title: Implement provenance and redistribution release gate
description: Audit LICENSE/NOTICE and all distribution surfaces; define prominent modification notice practice; populate the file-level provenance ledger; add dependency license scanning, SBOM and bundled notices; require approval before importing competitor code or using protected marks.

title: Specify governance entities, versions, and migrations
description: Define tenant, principal, group, role, access profile, entitlement, virtual-key lifecycle, policy version, audit event and capability schemas. Include indexes, uniqueness, ownership, soft-delete/retention, mixed-version migrations, rollback limits and tenant isolation.

title: Build one explainable deny-by-default entitlement evaluator
description: Evaluate enabled identity/key, team/BU/profile grants and explicit restrictions as intersections. Use identical decisions for model listing and invocation. Return stable reason codes and an administrator-safe explanation without secrets. Unit-test empty, wildcard, conflict and precedence cases.

title: Add server capability manifest and UI route gating
description: Expose authenticated versioned capabilities only when backing store/API/authz/telemetry is live. UI navigation and routes consume it, eliminating build-time assumptions and upsell placeholders. Tests prove disabled features are absent and direct navigation is safe.

title: Harden key storage and lifecycle state machine
description: Store opaque reveal-once secrets only as keyed hashes/fingerprints; implement pending/active/rotating/revoked/expired, not-before/expiry, stable IDs, rotation families, constant-time verification, log redaction and migrations from compatible OSS keys.

title: Implement transactional create, rotate, revoke, bulk and top-up APIs
description: Mutations require scoped RBAC and idempotency keys, commit durable audit/invalidation outbox events, return resource versions, never re-reveal old secrets, support bounded overlap/emergency rotation, and expose per-item bulk failures.

title: Prove cross-pod key coherence and bounded revocation
description: Implement versioned invalidation consumption and cache freshness leases. Test a key created on pod A across all pods, duplicate/reordered events, disconnection, revocation under load, emergency rotation and fail-closed behavior after the staleness SLO.

title: Design and implement atomic quota reservation primitives
description: Use shared atomic operations for RPM/TPM/concurrency/spend across all applicable scopes. Reserve estimates before upstream work, attach request/attempt idempotency, return tightest denial, and ensure concurrent pods cannot race beyond the documented bound.

title: Reconcile actual usage, retries, streaming and abandoned reservations
description: Define charges/refunds for success, provider errors, timeouts, cancellations, retry/fallback/canary/shadow. Reconcile provider usage idempotently, repair expired reservations without granting credit, and keep an auditable ledger.

title: Ship limit administration, immediate top-ups, reset semantics and 429 contract
description: Top-ups and policy changes become visible across pods immediately and are audited. Define rolling/calendar windows, timezone/DST, burst and overdraft. Denials include stable code, limiting scope, reset/window and Retry-After where meaningful.

title: Implement secure OIDC Authorization Code plus PKCE
description: Validate discovery, issuer, audience, nonce, state and PKCE; cache/refresh JWKS safely; encrypt sessions and refresh tokens; implement logout/revocation; map verified claims only; test rotation, replay, CSRF and unavailable IdP behavior.

title: Implement standards-complete inbound SCIM Users and Groups
description: Provide RFC 7643/7644 resources with bearer auth, ServiceProviderConfig/Schemas, pagination, filters, PATCH, ETags, idempotent retries, membership and deactivation. Fuzz parsers and test Okta-compatible group push without conflating SCIM with directory APIs.

title: Implement Okta directory import and reconciliation separately
description: Use scoped API credentials, pagination/rate handling, checkpoints, dry-run preview and resumability. Reconcile users/groups/deactivation and surface failures. Never silently overwrite manually managed resources.

title: Map groups and claims to roles, teams, business units and access profiles
description: Version mappings and precedence; issue/update managed virtual keys from profiles; revoke derived rights on removal within SLO; support explain-access and consistent model-list/invoke results. Test multiple groups, conflicts and deprovisioning.

title: Implement cluster runtime, invalidation transport and durable authority boundaries
description: Use membership/discovery for health and version distribution while PostgreSQL/shared counters remain authoritative. Authenticate/encrypt node traffic, version messages, tolerate duplicates/reordering, expose lag/health and document fail-open/closed policy per subsystem.

title: Harden Kubernetes deployment and autoscaling
description: Add readiness/startup/liveness semantics, SIGTERM streaming drain, HPA CPU plus concurrency/queue/latency metrics, PDB, topology spread, anti-affinity, resources and network policy. Validate rendered Helm schemas and secure defaults.

title: Build three-pod chaos, partition and rolling-upgrade conformance suite
description: Exercise pod death, delayed invalidation, counter loss, DB failover, singleton lease fencing, multi-zone partition and mixed-version migration. Assert requests, keys, counters and security policies meet explicit availability/consistency contracts.

title: Refactor routing into an ordered policy pipeline with explanations
description: Enforce authenticate, entitlement, quota, candidates, health/circuit, rollout bucket, weighted choice, invoke, retry/fallback, reconcile and observe. Later stages can never restore denied candidates; each decision is traceable and conformance-tested.

title: Implement adaptive provider/key weights and circuit breakers
description: Use bounded decayed error, latency, throughput and saturation signals with minimum samples, jittered half-open probes and per-key/model circuits. Expose reasons and safe manual controls; benchmark hot-path overhead.

title: Implement deterministic canary, shadow, promotion and rollback
description: Sticky bucket by configured tenant/key/user/session/trace, baseline/candidate percentages and windows. Shadow is separately budgeted/scrubbed/side-effect-disabled. Promotion needs samples, error/latency/cost gates and audited override; rollback is immediate.

title: Define secure immutable trace envelope and OTEL/OpenInference emission
description: Correlate policy, route, attempt, provider/model, tenant, key fingerprint, tokens, cost, cache and tools. Separate encrypted payload blobs from searchable metadata, apply redaction/retention and enforce tenant/RBAC access before export.

title: Implement dry-run/shadow replay jobs with side effects disabled
description: Snapshot route/model/provider/pricing/prompt/tool/evaluator versions. Default-block network/tools, require policy and audit for sandbox substitutes, support cancellation/resume, and diff outputs, tool trajectory, decisions, latency, tokens, cost and errors.

title: Add evaluator plugins, promotion integration and environment export
description: Support deterministic checks, rubrics, model judgments and safety evaluators with versioned results. Feed promotion gates. Export reviewed sanitized datasets plus harness/context/reward metadata for external Verifiers/OpenEnv-style systems; no online RL in gateway.

title: Replace dashboard information architecture and remove cruft
description: Inventory every route/chart/API. Remove duplicate/fake/upsell-only pages; capability-hide unfinished work. Define Overview, Keys, Identity, Entitlements, Limits, Routing, Cluster, Traces/Replays, Audit and reconciled Cost navigation with operator workflows.

title: Implement API-backed enterprise operator surfaces
description: Build accessible responsive surfaces with scoped RBAC, loading/empty/error states, explainability, mutation confirmation, audit correlation and no secret leakage. Preserve load-bearing data-testid conventions and shared components.

title: Add Playwright critical-flow and honesty tests
description: Cover key lifecycle, group/profile entitlement changes, immediate top-up, canary rollback, cluster degradation, replay safety and audit verification. Assert hidden capabilities cannot be reached directly and all displayed metrics reconcile to APIs.

title: Publish threat model and security architecture decisions
description: Analyze tenant escape, privilege escalation, stale authorization, key theft, counter bypass, confused deputy, SSRF/injection, malicious provider output, replay effects, audit tampering and control-plane compromise. Tie mitigations and residual risk to test beads.

title: Implement encryption, redaction, tenant scoping and tamper-evident audit
description: Use envelope encryption/rotation for secrets and payloads, structured redaction in logs/errors/traces, tenant predicates in every query, chained hashes or signed audit batches with verifier, and secure admin/SCIM API controls.

title: Add fuzz, race, chaos and authorization-boundary security suites
description: Fuzz SCIM filters/PATCH, CEL/policy and routing config; race caches/stores/counters; property-test entitlement monotonicity and ledger conservation; chaos-test stale auth and partitions; publish repeatable evidence and fix all release-blocking findings.

title: Make CI and release workflows fork-independent
description: Remove Maxim-owned registry/secret assumptions, pin actions/toolchains, minimize token permissions, separate untrusted PR jobs, cache safely, and orchestrate unit/race/integration/Playwright/Helm/multi-pod/upgrade/security/benchmark gates.

title: Produce signed reproducible release artifacts and attestations
description: Build cross-platform binaries, multi-arch OCI images, Helm chart and source archives; emit checksums, SPDX/CycloneDX SBOMs, license bundle, vulnerability/license reports and SLSA-compatible provenance; sign with keyless Sigstore where supported.

title: Verify clean-checkout install, upgrade, rollback and every published asset
description: Install artifacts without Maxim infrastructure; verify signatures/checksums/SBOM/notices, smoke actual inference and governance workflows, test schema mixed-version upgrade and documented rollback, and enforce performance regression budgets.

title: Run four grounded strong-model plan review rounds to structural steady state
description: Each round checks self-containment, DAG, rationale, source grounding, obscure-task implementability and structural diff. Resolve contradictions in the plan and beads; retain review evidence and do not begin swarm implementation while structural changes remain.

title: Polish and validate beads graph at least six rounds
description: Ensure every bead is self-contained, bounded, dependency-linked, testable and retains all requirements. Run br dep cycles, bv --robot-insights and bv --robot-plan; fix cycles, orphans, bottlenecks, missing tests and unsafe parallelism. Never run bare bv.

title: Launch a small NTM implementation swarm only after contracts stabilize
description: Discover robot capabilities, align session/project, use strong reviewers for security/control-plane foundations and cheaper workers only for bounded tasks. Each agent claims one ready bead, reserves files/worktree, posts evidence, closes and flushes. Diagnose degraded mail/CASS before restart.

title: Maintain history-derived gateway competitor and feature ledger
description: Recover prior State of AI decisions with session evidence, distinguish remembered decisions from new research, verify every unstable claim against current primary sources, and keep docs/roadmap/gateway-feature-landscape.md plus provenance rows current.

title: ADR: choose cross-pod config and revocation propagation
description: Launch constraints select Aurora PostgreSQL transactional outbox plus cursor polling, with LISTEN/NOTIFY as an optional low-latency wakeup and atomic local snapshot swaps. Prove 1-5s revocation/policy-reduction propagation, durable catch-up, listener recovery through Aurora failover/RDS Proxy, monotonic revisions, freshness leases and fail-closed behavior. Redis/gossip/shared files are comparison evidence or future adapters, not launch dependencies.

title: ADR: choose hard quota counter authority and reconciliation
description: Redis cannot be mandatory. Compare and benchmark Aurora atomic SQL reservation designs: sharded time buckets, idempotent reservation rows, short row/advisory locks, durable ledger, reconciliation and optional bounded local escrow. Controlled overdraft must come only from a preconfigured user/team policy or explicit approval, with alert and audit requirements. Preserve CounterAuthority interface for optional future accelerators.

title: ADR: choose membership, health and large-snapshot mechanisms
description: Launch uses Kubernetes EndpointSlice/watch and readiness for membership. Evaluate database heartbeat only for operator visibility/fencing. Defer memberlist, non-Kubernetes discovery and shared filesystem. Large bootstrap/DR snapshots may use signed S3 artifacts after evidence; ordinary changes use PostgreSQL outbox/deltas.

title: ADR: choose multi-region control-plane and regional data-plane topology
description: Launch uses one U.S. Aurora control-plane writer; temporary control-plane mutation outage during regional failure is acceptable. Specify bounded-fresh data-plane continuation, hard-reservation behavior during DB outage, active/passive DR/fencing, RTO/RPO and future evolution without building active/active writes.

title: Implement Bedrock runtime, Mantle, CRIS, AIP and provisioned target taxonomy
description: Model Bedrock runtime, bedrock-mantle Projects/Workspaces, U.S. geographic CRIS system profiles, Application Inference Profiles and Provisioned Throughput as distinct target capabilities. Global CRIS is disabled at launch. Add IAM/SCP/residency preflight, destination drift discovery, quota burndown, prompt-cache metrics and actual inference-region evidence.

title: Enforce independent model and Bedrock Guardrail processing residency
description: Compile tenant residency policy against both model CRIS destination sets and cross-region guardrail profiles. Reject invalid combinations before routing and record both actual/allowed processing destinations in route evidence and audit.

title: Normalize logprobs, logit bias and tokenizer capability semantics
description: Preserve provider-native token bytes/text, logprob, alternatives, rank, position and finish reason; distinguish unsupported/unavailable/omitted/redacted; ensure unary/stream parity and per-target maximums. Reject incompatible logit_bias instead of dropping it. Treat payloads as sensitive and never compare tokenizers without calibration.

title: Specify versioned composable route DAG and offline simulator
description: Support condition, hard constraint, quota/budget gate, weighted/sticky split, endpoint timeout/retry, fallback and terminal nodes. Validate, simulate and explain candidate rejection/score/attempts before atomic activation; preserve last-known-good and monotonic revisions.

title: Operationalize identity-to-routing-to-evaluation governance flywheel
description: Connect IdP group/claim to roles/teams/profiles/managed keys, hard capability and data policy, attributed traces/cost/quality/safety feedback, reviewed profile/router revisions, canary and audited promotion. Feedback and learned routing can optimize only inside human-governed eligible sets; enforce tenant-scoped datasets and deprovisioning.

title: Define branchable RL trajectory and external environment gateway contract
description: Represent environment/policy versions, reset seed/state, observations, actions/tools, per-turn logprobs, component rewards, termination/truncation, branch parent, sandbox provenance and timing. Provide separate rollout admission queue and OpenAI policy plus reset/step/state adapter for Verifiers/OpenEnv/TRL-style workers outside the online path.

title: Implement PostgreSQL-native distributed quota reservation prototype
description: Prototype multiple Aurora-safe reservation schemas without Redis: per-scope/window sharded counters, idempotent reservation ledger, estimated token/spend reserve, actual reconciliation and expiration. Benchmark multi-pod concurrency, lock wait, deadlocks, WAL/I/O and hot-tenant behavior; retain only the simplest design meeting launch throughput.

title: Implement controlled overdraft approval, policy and alerting workflow
description: Overdraft is allowed only by a preconfigured user/team rule or explicit approval. Define amount/time/model scope, approver RBAC, expiry, idempotency and audit. Alert affected user and operators at warning, breach, approval, consumption and expiry through configurable in-product plus webhook/email channels. Emergency top-up must propagate within 1-5 seconds.

title: E12 Governed learning, distillation, and model lifecycle
description: Turn consented traces into governed datasets, evaluations, external training jobs and fully provenanced model artifacts. Support teacher/student distillation and blind side-by-side comparisons, then shadow/canary promotion. Keep GPU training and arbitrary graders in isolated Kubernetes workers.

title: Implement privacy-tiered trace capture and training eligibility
description: Add metadata-only, redacted, encrypted-full and explicitly training-eligible modes. Enforce U.S.-only inference/trace/evaluator/replay/training egress separately; record consent/purpose, scanner/redaction versions, retention, licenses/terms and deletion tombstones. Default traces are not training consent.

title: Implement immutable LearningDataset snapshots and compiler
description: Compile trace queries into content-addressed SFT, preference, prompt-only, trajectory, vision, behavioral-distillation or logit-distillation datasets. Deduplicate, prevent split leakage, balance cohorts, freeze holdouts, preserve teacher/tool/template provenance, reference encrypted blobs and support deletion propagation.

title: Implement evaluator registry and governed human annotation queues
description: Version deterministic, LLM-judge, pairwise, semantic, trajectory, safety, performance and human rubrics with exact prompts/models/code digests/calibration/cost. Add reviewer RBAC/reservations, blinded comparison, corrections, agreement/adjudication and audit. Execute code graders only in sandboxes.

title: Implement blind side-by-side and repeated-sample comparison
description: Compare baseline, teacher, base student, trained student, prompt/router and provider candidates on identical immutable datasets and evaluator versions. Capture repeated seeds/samples, output/tool diffs, latency/TTFT/tokens/cost/reward, win-tie-loss, confidence/effect size, slice results and annotations.

title: Implement provider-neutral TrainingJob registry and worker protocol
description: Define method/backend/base/teacher/dataset/evaluator/hyperparameter/container/hardware/secret/egress/checkpoint/cost/output contract for SFT, DPO, KTO, GRPO, RLOO, RFT, LoRA, QLoRA, behavioral/logit distillation and prompt optimization. Sign specs and run workers outside gateway pods.

title: Implement signed ModelArtifact and adapter registry
description: Record complete base/teacher/job/dataset lineage, adapter/merged/quantization, all licenses/terms, tokenizer/chat-template/BOS-EOS/generation defaults, capabilities, file digests, signature/SBOM/scans, runtime compatibility, eval evidence, aliases and promotion history. Block artifacts missing required template/tokenizer metadata.

title: Implement isolated Unsloth and Hugging Face TRL Kubernetes adapters
description: Generate pinned job configs for external workers supporting selected LoRA/QLoRA/SFT/preference/GRPO/distillation recipes. Preserve full algorithm-specific config, runtime/kernel/GPU versions, reward/verifier versions and sampled groups/logprobs. Do not copy AGPL Unsloth Studio into the Apache fork.

title: Implement teacher-student distillation pipelines
description: Support behavioral-output, preference/reward, router/prompt and optional logit distillation as separate schemas. Freeze teacher/student/prompt/tool/template, curate candidates, validate graders, use untouched holdout, compare teacher/base/trained student, canary and rollback. Require tokenizer alignment for token-distribution methods.

title: Implement evidence-gated model promotion and rollback
description: Require provenance/license/signature/scan success, holdout and critical-slice non-regression, safety/privacy/tool/reward-hacking checks, cost/latency thresholds, sample/confidence gates, shadow then session-sticky canary, armed alerts and permitted human or pre-approved policy signature.

title: Add portable Phoenix, AgentCore, DSPy, Prime and OpenAI adapters
description: Use OpenInference/OTel as canonical substrate. Integrate self-hosted Phoenix first, then versioned adapters for AgentCore eval/optimization, DSPy trials, Prime/OpenEnv trajectories and OpenAI eval/training services. No adapter may become the internal source of truth or write production config directly.

title: Prove policy monotonicity across aliases, catalogs, retries, fallbacks and replay
description: Reproduce upstream issue #4243 and build property/conformance tests showing governance filters only narrow candidate sets. Cover model catalog fallback, aliases, provider/key failover, adaptive routing, canary/shadow and replay. Any path that restores a denied provider/model/key is release-blocking.

title: Specify explicit hierarchical budget algebra and decision receipts
description: Define composition across org, team, user, virtual key, task, model and provider including controlled overdraft. Eliminate ambiguous override semantics exposed by competitor issues. Return a stable receipt listing evaluated scopes, reservations, limiting or overdraft rule, approval and reconciliation.

title: Implement retrieval-aware and calibrated difficulty routing research prototype
description: Evaluate rules, embeddings and learned scorers for retrieval need and task difficulty. Measure confidence, calibration, OOD and slice behavior through offline replay. Hard policy filters precede scoring and low-confidence/OOD requests fall back to a safe configured route.

title: Implement versioned pricing ledger and cross-provider cost conformance
description: Version price rules by provider/model/key/service tier/context/cache/batch/container and effective time. Build fixtures for tiered pricing and reconcile estimated, provider-reported and billed cost. Dashboard reads the ledger rather than duplicating pricing math.

title: Implement MCP credential delegation and outbound parameter firewall
description: Separate caller, gateway workload and narrowly delegated downstream identity. Never forward original authorization by default. Add per-tool parameter schemas/policies, secret redaction, egress allowlists, consent, audit and confused-deputy tests across virtual keys and user sessions.

title: E13 Prove the base repository, language and product distribution
description: Run the reversible compatibility-distribution experiment defined in docs/roadmap/base-repo-language-and-product-decision.md. Preserve Bifrost provider/stream/MCP behavior while creating fork-owned policy and evidence seams. The exit states are maintainable downstream distribution or incremental engine replacement; a big-bang rewrite is not an allowed implicit outcome.

title: Reproduce upstream build and map the complete release surface
description: From a clean pinned upstream checkout, reproduce tests and binary/image/chart/source outputs. Inventory Go modules/tags, registries, CI secrets, signing, SBOM, source correspondence, Apache license/NOTICE/modification duties, Maxim URLs and branding. Produce a release gap ledger and stop rather than claiming release readiness when the baseline is not reproducible.

Preserve MLflow GenAI versus classic evaluation schemas and never run arbitrary Python or evaluator work in gateway latency pools.

title: Run an upstream merge drill and private release rehearsal
description: Merge the newest upstream into the experiment branch, record conflict hours, touched upstream files and semantic diffs, rerun conformance and three-pod tests, then install/upgrade/rollback signed private prerelease binary/image/chart/source artifacts with SBOM and license evidence. title: Identify and run a bounded Rust candidate bakeoff
description: Do not block Go delivery. Identify the rumored archived Rust gateway by URL and audit license, archive status, providers, Bedrock, streaming, Responses, MCP, CVEs, dependencies and tests. For any bounded Rust component require 100 percent scoped conformance, safe Go fallback and at least 20 percent improvement in a binding p99/CPU/RSS workload including RPC operations costs.

title: E14 Govern MCP, tool search and the approved skill marketplace
description: Implement docs/roadmap/mcp-tool-skill-governance-and-research.md. The gateway owns signed catalogs, policy-first discovery, credential and invocation governance, audit/replay and kill switches. Skill execution remains sandboxed externally. Visibility, discovery, installation and invocation are separate decisions.

title: Implement immutable signed server, tool and skill manifests
description: Add publisher/source/digest/version/license/SBOM, owner/reviewer, lifecycle/expiry, capabilities/scopes/residency, schema/examples/tests/side-effects and rollback. Support sanctioned, restricted, quarantined, prohibited and deprecated states. Manifest or capability mutations create diffs and reapproval/quarantine policy.

title: Implement policy-first deferred tool discovery
description: Build tenant and org/team/user/agent-scoped ToolCatalog snapshots. Filter authorization before hybrid lexical/dense retrieval; support pinned tools, defer_loading, name/summary/full expansion, aliases/collision quarantine, deterministic ranking and caches keyed by policy/catalog revision. Audit candidates/scores/filters and measure authorized recall@k plus downstream success.

title: Implement MCP invocation firewall and result trust boundary
description: Enforce strict schema and parameter ABAC for paths/URIs/SQL/egress, redaction, fanout, timeout, result size, rate/cost, idempotency and dry-run. Add side-effect risk classes and approvals. Treat results as untrusted/tainted with provenance, DLP and entitlement checks; returned instructions never escalate authority.

title: Implement per-call attenuated MCP credential broker
description: Issue short-lived audience/scope-bound downstream credentials based on caller, group, purpose, tool and parameter decision. Never pass original authorization by default or persist secrets in traces. Support rotation, revocation across pods, consent, audit and confused-deputy tests.

title: Distribute MCP catalog, grant, health and kill-switch snapshots
description: Use Aurora authority plus transactional outbox/cursor/wakeup and atomic local snapshots. Meet the 1-5 second reduction/revocation target without mandatory Redis. Detect capability changes, drain connections, invalidate caches, preserve region affinity and expose per-tenant/server/tool circuit breakers.

title: Implement provider tool-search and tool-dialect compatibility
description: Preserve Anthropic deferred loading/tool references, OpenAI client-executed search and MCP events, Google IDs/signatures, and model-specific Qwen/Kimi/GLM parsers. Pin template/parser hashes, requested/effective parameter transforms and reasoning fields; reject unsupported combinations.

title: Build adversarial MCP and multi-turn trajectory conformance packs

title: Evaluate tenant-local semantic search and privacy leakage
description: Only after lexical launch: benchmark recall/cost, ACL filtering before embeddings, inversion/membership leakage, model provenance, index deletion and deterministic fallback.

title: Add managed-evidence quotas, observability, support and disaster recovery
description: Bound bytes/docs/embeddings/queries/cardinality/retention; expose loss/degraded counters; rehearse restore, crypto-shred, legal hold and corrupted-index recovery.

title: Run employee-monitoring, labor, legal and social acceptability review
description: Prohibit individual productivity scoring and covert surveillance; define consent, transparency, manager access, minimum aggregation and appeals before organization analytics.

title: Define evidence trust, taint, terminal outcome and missingness authority
description: Every observation records source type, verification state, authenticated reporter, taint lineage, assignment/propensity, terminal disposition, privacy/deletion lineage and evidence-plane health. Native JSM effectiveness, CM marks, frequency and CASS rank are weak observations only. Promotion rejects unknown or arm-differential capture.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- AgentEvidenceEnvelope schema requires source_type, verification_state, authenticated_reporter, taint lineage, assignment propensity, terminal disposition, privacy receipt, deletion lineage and evidence health.
- Unit and conformance tests reject native JSM, CM, frequency or CASS-rank records as decisive promotion evidence.
- Property tests reconcile assigned units to every terminal and missing disposition without treating unknown as success.
- Integration tests prove arm-differential missingness blocks promotion with a stable reason code.
- Golden schema fixtures and source-to-envelope provenance are reviewed and version pinned.

title: Define immutable JSM SkillOperationalContract and registry
description: Content-address every skill revision and freeze purpose, triggers, abstention, schemas, dependencies, permissions, budgets, failure/rollback behavior and executable validators. Reject mutable refs, missing owners/licenses/signatures, undeclared capabilities, self-approval and incompatible scope/risk combinations.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- SkillOperationalContract schema freezes purpose, triggers, abstention, schemas, immutable dependencies, permissions, budgets, failure behavior, validators, owners, license and signatures.
- Unit and conformance tests reject mutable dependency refs, undeclared capabilities, missing owners, self-approval and incompatible risk/scope combinations.
- Round-trip and golden tests prove canonical serialization and content-addressed revision identity.
- Integration tests generate deterministic permission/dependency diffs and transitive blast radius.
- Registry tenant-isolation tests prove Tenant A cannot list, read, invoke or infer Tenant B revisions.

title: Build skill evaluation bundle, missingness and causal experiment harness
description: Freeze sampling manifest, leakage groups, evaluator/runner revisions, goldens, conformance, metamorphic, fuzz, adversarial, replay and separated holdouts. Reconcile every assignment to terminal outcome or explicit missingness; report case evidence, n/missing/CI/effect by critical slices. Before-after evidence cannot yield causal promotion.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- Evaluation bundles freeze sampling, leakage groups, missingness, evaluators, runner, goldens, conformance, metamorphic, fuzz, replay and separated holdouts.
- Deterministic reruns produce identical decisions; stochastic runs preserve seeds, samples and distributions.
- Scorecards report case observations plus n, missing n, confidence interval and effect by every critical slice.
- Before/after-only evidence and differential capture loss are rejected as causal promotion evidence.
- Bundle compilation p95 < 100ms for 10,000 metadata-only case references excluding suite execution, with a benchmark and regression threshold.
- Conformance, property, metamorphic, golden, fuzz and mock-free E2E requirements in the evaluation specification pass.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

title: Enforce evaluator and meta-skill non-self-modification separation
description: Candidate behavior and decisive evaluator cannot change in one promotion unit. Keep prior evaluator as shadow oracle during migration; independently calibrate evaluator changes. A meta-skill cannot modify its own evaluator, permissions, evidence eligibility, approval policy, hard floors or rollback threshold.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- Registry transactions reject a behavior candidate whose decisive evaluator changes in the same promotion unit.
- Unit and state-machine tests deny meta-skill changes to its own evaluator, permissions, evidence policy, approval floors or rollback threshold.
- Integration tests retain the prior production evaluator as a shadow oracle during evaluator migration.
- Conformance tests require independent evaluator calibration, ownership and signed approval.
- Adversarial E2E attempts through API, worker, import and recovery surfaces all fail with the same stable reason.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

title: Implement distributed skill recall, descendant quarantine and deletion revalidation
description: Rollback expires or re-attests cached high-risk clients, quarantines transitive dependents, taints evidence from recalled revisions and records external compensation separately. Evidence deletion runs influence analysis and moves affected skills to revalidation, restriction or rollback.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- Rollback receipt changes canonical alias, creates recall epoch, identifies every transitive dependent and taints resulting evidence.
- Graph property and metamorphic tests quarantine all descendants regardless of traversal order, cycles or diamond dependencies.
- Multi-client E2E proves offline high-risk clients expire or re-attest before later execution.
- Deletion integration tests run influence analysis and move under-supported revisions to revalidation, restriction or rollback.
- External side-effect compensation remains a distinct recorded workflow and is never falsely reported as artifact rollback.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

title: Red-team aggregate skill analytics for employee singling-out
description: Enforce minimum cohort after every filter/export, complementary-cell suppression and repeated-query differencing resistance. Personal analytics remain user-visible only; prohibit employment decisions and manager nomination of private evidence for organization promotion.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- Analytics queries enforce minimum cohort after every filter and export, complementary-cell suppression and repeated-query privacy budgets.
- Integration tests use at least two teams and adversarial overlapping filters that would otherwise isolate one employee.
- API/E2E tests prove personal analytics are visible to the subject but unavailable for ordinary manager ranking.
- Policy conformance tests prohibit employment-action purpose and manager nomination of an individual's private corpus.
- Security-incident access uses a distinct time-bounded authorization and emits an auditable receipt.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

title: Build privacy-gated EvidenceEnvelopeBuilder and bounded durable outbox
description: Deep-copy completed trace data, allowlist fields and headers, hard-deny credentials, independently transform MCP args/results/plugin logs/errors and emit PrivacyTransformReceipt. Observability Inject only serializes/enqueues stable idempotent events to bounded WAL/outbox with retry, DLQ, shutdown drain, health and explicit metadata-only/drop policy; inference never waits.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- EvidenceEnvelopeBuilder deep-copies and canonicalizes eligible trace data and emits a versioned PrivacyTransformReceipt.
- Unit, fuzz and privacy-canary tests deny credentials in headers, trace attributes, plugin logs, MCP data, errors and nested encodings.
- Outbox uses stable idempotency keys, bounded bytes/events, retry ceiling, poison DLQ, shutdown drain and explicit metadata-only/drop/reject policy.
- Fault-injection integration tests cover disk full, DB unavailable, poison event, crash and restart without unbounded memory or silent policy change.
- Inference latency regression is < 1% at p99 under normal exporter load and remains within the declared SLO when consumers are stopped.
- Rollback disables the exporter and drains or quarantines the spool without deleting authoritative accepted evidence.

title: Refactor MCP invocation so mandatory policy precedes credential and connection acquisition
description: Resolve immutable tool/client manifest without credentials, run mandatory parameter/approval policy, then issue attenuated credential and acquire connection. Finalize denied/preparation-failed/ambiguous executions into evidence receipts. Replace permissive eager injection with authorized signed catalog snapshots.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- MCP execution order is normalize immutable target, mandatory policy, attenuated credential, connection, wire call and terminal receipt.
- Unit and sequence-conformance tests prove denied calls issue zero credentials, acquire zero connections and send zero upstream packets.
- Integration tests finalize policy denial, preparation failure, timeout and ambiguous completion into distinct evidence states.
- Authorized catalog snapshots replace permissive eager/server-wide grants and bind exact tool/schema digests.
- Mock-free MCP E2E covers alias collision, stale tool, injected arguments/results, pod loss and reconnect.
- Rollback feature flag restores the prior execution path only in environments where mandatory MCP invocation is disabled.

title: Implement Flywheel specification-derived conformance harness
description: Enumerate EV-MUST/SHOULD requirements from the evaluation conformance spec, attach stable IDs to executable tests, generate COVERAGE and compliance JSON/Markdown, track intentional deviations as XFAIL with owner/review date, and refuse conformance with any untested MUST.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- COVERAGE maps every EV-MUST and EV-SHOULD ID to an executable test and source requirement.
- All 20 MUST requirements have 100% tested coverage; no MUST may be SKIP.
- Known divergences use XFAIL with owner, rationale, affected cases and review date in DISCREPANCIES.md.
- Conformance runner emits deterministic compliance JSON and Markdown with passing, failing, XFAIL and untested counts.
- CI regression tests prove a deliberately removed MUST test makes the harness report non-conformant.
notes: Launch scope is the canonical contract/privacy/MR authorization subset described in docs/roadmap/jsm-flywheel-evaluation-conformance-spec.md; the full Flywheel matrix is a maturity target.

title: Implement provenance-backed Flywheel golden artifact suite
description: Canonicalize and freeze reviewed skill contracts, envelopes, scorecards, promotion/rollback receipts and dependency graphs. Record generator/source/privacy/reviewer provenance; forbid CI auto-update; emit reviewable diffs and split artifacts over 100 KB.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- Canonical goldens cover contracts, envelopes, scorecards, promotion/rollback receipts and dependency graphs.
- Every fixture records generator command, source revision, dependency lock, privacy class and human reviewer in PROVENANCE.md.
- Unit and snapshot tests scrub only approved dynamic fields and preserve security-relevant differences.
- CI cannot update goldens and uploads .actual plus unified diffs on mismatch.
- Review tooling rejects artifacts over 100KB unless decomposed or explicitly approved with rationale.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

title: Implement Flywheel metamorphic and mutation-testing suite
description: Implement only scored MRs at or above 2.0 using property-based generation, including ID rename, reorder, dedup, privacy loss, permission change, evaluator change, deletion and rollback graph relations. Plant the documented mutations and require at least 80 percent kill rate or justified equivalent/unreachable classification.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- All implemented metamorphic relations have strength score >= 2.0 and property-based generators.
- Suite includes ID rename, reorder, dedup, privacy loss, permission change, evaluator change, deletion and rollback graph relations.
- Every relation kills at least one documented planted mutation.
- Aggregate mutation kill rate is >= 80%, with every survivor classified as killed, equivalent, unreachable or coverage gap.
- Compound rename-reorder-dedup and privacy-loss-pod-count-replay relations run deterministically in CI.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

title: Implement structure-aware fuzz and real-service Flywheel E2E campaigns
description: Add narrow Go fuzz targets for envelopes, contracts, reducers, state machines, graphs, privacy, outbox, MCP, pools and assignment; enforce throughput/corpus/triage gates. Add real PostgreSQL and multi-process E2E for outage isolation, loss, convergence, deletion, recall, MCP ordering, privacy canaries, evaluator separation, differencing and mixed versions.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- Narrow Go fuzz targets cover envelopes, contracts, reducers, lifecycle graphs, privacy, outbox, MCP, pooled reset and canary assignment.
- Parser targets sustain >= 1000 exec/s and stateful targets >= 100 exec/s on the documented CI runner with bounded inputs and minimized corpora.
- Every fuzz failure is minimized, root-cause deduplicated and converted into a permanent regression test.
- Mock-free PostgreSQL and multi-process E2E executes all ten scenarios in the evaluation specification with structured JSONL evidence.
- Evidence-plane outage adds < 1% p99 inference latency under the declared load and cannot cause unbounded memory.
- Production endpoint blocklists and cleanup registry are tested before real-service suites run.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

title: Build canonical evidence parser and cross-language differential corpus
description: Define one normalization and canonical hashing contract for envelopes, identities, model/tool aliases and JSON. Reject duplicate keys and ambiguous encodings. Run the same hostile Unicode/encoding/path/alias corpus across Go and every endpoint collector; require identical canonical value or rejection.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- One canonical normalization and hashing specification covers envelopes, identities, aliases, Unicode, paths and JSON.
- Parsers reject duplicate keys, ambiguous encodings, non-canonical aliases and size/depth violations with stable categories.
- Cross-language differential conformance corpus yields identical canonical value or identical rejection in Go and every supported collector.
- Round-trip, fuzz and golden tests preserve original transport hash separately from canonical content hash.
- A parser/version mismatch prevents promotion and triggers explicit quarantine rather than best-effort ingestion.

title: Prove restore replay reindex and backfill cannot resurrect revoked authority
description: Persist tombstone and revocation epochs independently of disposable indexes; bind restore manifests and snapshot watermarks; make reconciliation decay authority only. Restore pre-deletion/pre-recall snapshots and verify current deletion, hold and recall state wins before query, evaluation or invocation.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- Tombstone and revocation epochs are authoritative outside disposable indexes and are included in signed snapshot/restore manifests.
- Restore, replay, reindex, backfill and migration paths enforce identical tenant, privacy, signature and authorization policy.
- Mock-free recovery E2E restores a pre-deletion and pre-recall snapshot and proves current state wins before query or invocation.
- Property tests prove reconciliation monotonically decays authority and never republishes or raises privilege.
- Legal hold versus deletion produces an explicit conflict state and audit receipt.
- Rollback of recovery code leaves authoritative tombstones and revocation epochs intact.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

title: Enforce per-tenant Flywheel resource and denial-of-wallet isolation
description: Bound bytes, nesting, cardinality, retries, cost, concurrency and storage per tenant/user/job; quarantine poison events; use fair admission/compaction and metadata-only downgrade. Adversarial load from one tenant must not violate another tenant's inference or evidence SLO.
acceptance_criteria:
Done when:
- Admission enforces per-tenant/user/job byte, depth, cardinality, retry, cost, concurrency and storage budgets before expensive parsing or model calls.
- Poison events are quarantined after a bounded retry count and cannot pin global compaction or another tenant's cursor.
- Unit, integration, conformance, fuzz, load and mock-free E2E tests cover deep nesting, expansion bombs, high cardinality, endless revisions and evaluator cost attacks.
- Under adversarial Tenant A load, Tenant B inference and evidence p99 remain within declared SLO and memory remains bounded.
- Metadata-only downgrade, drop and reject decisions emit stable counters and receipts.
- Circuit breaker or feature flag disables expensive proposal/evaluator work without disabling inference or authoritative evidence durability.
notes: Deferred from the internal-marketplace launch path. Reconsider if autonomous merging, external publishers, offline distribution, employee analytics, or evidence-based production selection is introduced.

description: Implemented /livez process-only, /readyz dependency-aware, /startupz post-bootstrap routes; kept /health compatibility; whitelisted and excluded probes from logging; updated Helm deployment/stateful defaults, schema, chart v2.1.29, docs, and tests.
